pageTitle: Advanced Master-Detail View - Angular Data Grid | Angular Example
h1: Angular Data Grid - Advanced Master-Detail View
descriptionEn: This demo illustrates an advanced master-detail view in the DataGrid component. Master rows represent suppliers. Detail sections contain TabPanel components with two tabs: Orders and Address. In the Orders tab, you can choose a supplier's product from the SelectBox, and the DataGrid under it will show orders placed on this product. The Address tab displays the supplier's address.
